columns.name: corridor_id
columns.description: Stable identifier for one directional corridor.

columns.name: interstate_name
columns.description: Interstate the corridor belongs to, like I-10.

columns.name: direction_code
columns.description: Canonical travel direction, like east.

columns.name: direction_label
columns.description: Capitalized form of direction_code.

columns.name: geometry_geojson
columns.description: Corridor geometry as GeoJSON LineString or MultiLineString text.

columns.name: edge_count
columns.description: Number of graph edges assigned to the corridor.

columns.name: edge_id
columns.description: Deterministic edge identifier, like edge/I-35E/10125498410/82123455.

columns.name: corridor_id
columns.description: Corridor the edge belongs to.

columns.name: interstate_name
columns.description: Interstate of the parent corridor.

columns.name: direction_code
columns.description: Canonical direction of the parent corridor.

columns.name: length_m
columns.description: Edge length in meters.

columns.name: geometry_geojson
columns.description: Edge geometry as GeoJSON LineString text.

tables.name: corridor_exits
tables.description: Normalized exits linked to a corridor.

columns.name: exit_id
columns.description: OSM-derived exit identifier, like node/338162665.

columns.name: corridor_id
columns.description: Corridor the exit sits on.

columns.name: interstate_name
columns.description: Interstate of the parent corridor.

columns.name: direction_code
columns.description: Canonical direction of the parent corridor.

columns.name: sequence_index
columns.description: Zero-based position of the exit along the corridor.

columns.name: exit_number
columns.description: Posted exit number from OSM, like 1A. May be empty.

columns.name: exit_name
columns.description: Exit name from OSM. May be empty.

columns.name: lat
columns.description: Exit latitude in WGS84.

columns.name: lon
columns.description: Exit longitude in WGS84.

columns.name: geometry_geojson
columns.description: Exit location as GeoJSON Point text.

tables.name: exit_aliases
tables.description: Source exit aliases mapped to normalized exits.
tables.note: Ships empty in the current release. The alias-normalization layer is not yet populated.

columns.name: canonical_exit_id
columns.description: Normalized exit that aliases collapse into.

columns.name: source_exit_id
columns.description: Source exit mapped onto the canonical exit.

columns.name: place_id
columns.description: OSM-derived place identifier, like node/10000051746.

columns.name: category
columns.description: Place category, like evCharging or restArea.

columns.name: name
columns.description: Name from OSM.

columns.name: display_name
columns.description: Name prepared for display.

columns.name: brand
columns.description: Brand from OSM. May be empty.

columns.name: geometry_geojson
columns.description: Place location as GeoJSON Point text.

tables.name: exit_place_links
tables.description: Spatial proximity links between exits and places.

columns.name: exit_id
columns.description: Exit side of the link. Joins corridor_exits.exit_id.

columns.name: place_id
columns.description: Place side of the link. Joins places.place_id.

columns.name: category
columns.description: Category of the linked place.

columns.name: distance_m
columns.description: Distance from exit to place in meters.

columns.name: rank
columns.description: Proximity rank of the place for this exit, starting at 1.

tables.name: reference_routes
tables.description: Routes for QA, examples, and exploration.
tables.note: Only corridors that meet the route-builder thresholds are emitted. Short corridors may appear in corridors.csv without a matching reference route.

columns.name: reference_route_id
columns.description: Deterministic route identifier.

columns.name: interstate_name
columns.description: Interstate the route follows, like I-10.

columns.name: direction_code
columns.description: Compact direction code, like EB.

columns.name: direction_label
columns.description: Readable direction, like Eastbound.

columns.name: display_name
columns.description: Route name, like I-10 Eastbound.

columns.name: distance_m
columns.description: Route distance in meters.

columns.name: duration_s
columns.description: Estimated drive time in seconds.

columns.name: point_count
columns.description: Number of coordinates in the route geometry.

columns.name: geometry_geojson
columns.description: Route geometry as GeoJSON LineString or MultiLineString text.

tables.name: reachability
tables.description: OSRM driving distance, duration, and a score per exit-place pair.

columns.name: exit_id
columns.description: Exit being scored. Joins corridor_exits.exit_id in the core release.

columns.name: place_id
columns.description: Place being scored. Joins places.place_id in the core release.

columns.name: route_distance_m
columns.description: OSRM driving distance in meters. Empty when the pair is unreachable.

columns.name: route_duration_s
columns.description: OSRM driving time in seconds. Empty when the pair is unreachable.

columns.name: reachable
columns.description: Whether OSRM found a driving route between the pair (t or f).

columns.name: reachability_score
columns.description: 0 to 100, higher is easier to reach. Penalized by route distance and exit-to-place offset. 0 when unreachable.

columns.name: reachability_confidence
columns.description: Confidence in the score from 0 to 1. Decreases with route distance.

columns.name: provider
columns.description: Routing engine that scored the pair, currently osrm.

columns.name: provider_dataset_version
columns.description: Provider dataset version when recorded. May be empty.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.description: When the pair was scored, UTC.

tables.name: osrm_snap_hints
tables.description: Snapped coordinates and routing hints for incremental scoring runs.

columns.name: source_scope
columns.description: Source scope for the endpoint, like product.

columns.name: endpoint_kind
columns.description: Kind of snapped endpoint, like exit.

columns.name: endpoint_id
columns.description: OSM-derived identifier of the endpoint.

columns.name: dataset_key
columns.description: Key for the snapping dataset and config that produced the hint.

columns.name: input_lon
columns.description: Original longitude before snapping, WGS84.

columns.name: input_lat
columns.description: Original latitude before snapping, WGS84.

columns.name: snapped_lon
columns.description: Longitude snapped onto the routable road network.

columns.name: snapped_lat
columns.description: Latitude snapped onto the routable road network.

columns.name: hint
columns.description: Opaque OSRM hint token reused to skip re-snapping on later runs.

columns.name: snapped_distance_m
columns.description: Distance moved from the input point to the snapped point in meters.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.description: When the hint was produced, UTC.
